sources: NPS campgrounds API (developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=neri, 'Glade Creek Campground', read 2026-10-21), the data behind https://www.nps.gov/neri/planyourvisit/glade-creek-campground.htm

values.note: 'All sites are managed on a first-come, first-served basis and reservations are not accepted.' Camp only at designated sites; campers must occupy the site each night. 14 days in any 28-day period across the park's campgrounds.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/neri/planyourvisit/glade-creek-campground.htm (NPS campgrounds API: reservationInfo 'All sites are managed on a first-come, first-served basis and reservations are not accepted'; numberOfSitesReservable 0; regulations 'Camping limit of no more than a total of 14 days per 28-day period in any park campground'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.nps.gov/neri/planyourvisit/glade-creek-campground.htm (NPS campgrounds API operatingHours: 'Glade Creek Campground is open year round.'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/neri/planyourvisit/glade-creek-campground.htm (NPS campgrounds API: 'These primitive camping areas have no drinking water or hookups'; electricalHookups 0), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 5 drive-in sites for tents, RVs or campers (one accessible) and 6 walk-in tent sites. The drive-in sites take small (under 25 ft) and medium (22-31.5 ft) RVs or trailers; 'Large RVs or trailers are not recommended. There are no pull-through campsites.' One RV and one tent, 2 vehicles, 8 people per site.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/neri/planyourvisit/glade-creek-campground.htm (NPS campgrounds API: 'There are 6 walk-in tents sites and 5 drive-in sites for tents, RVs, or campers'; rvInfo 'Five campsites are drive in and can accommodate small (less than 25 feet in total length) and medium (22 - 31.5 feet in length) RVs or trailers ... There are no pull-through campsites'; rvMaxLength 31), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Composting toilets (year round), bear-proof trash collection; no water, no camp host.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/neri/planyourvisit/glade-creek-campground.htm (NPS campgrounds API amenities: toilets 'Composting Toilets - year round', showers 'None', potableWater 'No water', dumpStation 'No', laundry 'No', campStore 'No', internetConnectivity 'No'), read 2026-10-21

summary: NPS campground data: confirmed free (fees unchanged), first-come only (the inherited recreation.gov reservable is overridden: no reservations), open year round, no hookups or water, 11 sites (5 drive-in, RVs to 31 ft, no pull-throughs), composting toilets only. No current park alert for Glade Creek. Operator: National Park Service (New River Gorge). Note left as is.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the entry is 'not waterfront', while the note says 'sites directly adjacent to the creek' and NPS describes the campground as 'near the banks of the New River and the Glade Creek Trailhead'.
Website's second line is a recreation.gov POI page (https://www.recreation.gov/camping/poi/259059) for a campground that takes no reservations; the NPS page alone would do.
